title: Committing as a recurrence: fixed-latent SGF verification
source_version_note: Current local manuscript source; not an Overleaf revision or a claim about a remote commit.

theorem.chain_rule: d KV_b / d KV_j = J_b J_(b-1) ... J_(j+1), j < b
theorem.jacobian: J_k = d F_theta^c(x_k; KV_(k-1)) / d KV_(k-1)
theorem.kv_projection: From the layer input, before that layer attention
theorem.single_predecessor_layer_bound: KV_b^(ell) depends only on x_max(0,b-ell), ..., x_b
theorem.h_predecessor_layer_bound: With h_0 preceding blocks, earliest possible source is max(0,b-h_0*ell)
theorem.self_only_historical_derivatives: exactly zero under the fixed-input condition
theorem.base_persistent_sink: Direct dependence on block 0 from layer 1 onward
theorem.magnitude: Determined by the trained weights, within the permitted dependence
theorem.free_generation_note: Older history can also affect clean latents through denoising.

protocol.prompt_source: Self-Forcing expanded MovieGen list; separate diagnostic list shared with the fixed-trajectory recency probe
protocol.reference_generation: Base denoising and six-frame Commit Forcing
protocol.reconstruction: Committing alone with the clean latents fixed; no denoising or VAE decoding
protocol.two_position_averaging: Average the two intervention positions within each prompt, then average prompts
protocol.bootstrap_unit: prompt, keeping both intervention positions together
protocol.intervals: Reported prompt-bootstrap interval endpoints are retained in the aggregate plot inputs; no interval is recomputed here.

content_change.replacement: Commit block b* from the latent of block (b*+40) mod 80 in the same video

sink_change.replacement: Commit block 0, which also supplies the persistent sink, from block 40 latent

single_sink_read.context_size_control: Fixed for Commit Forcing and the two-block control; increases for self-only.

measurement.tensor_scope: Block m own KV slots in layer ell; all selected tokens, heads and channels
measurement.k_v_normalization: Separate denominators for K and V
measurement.layer_mean_kv: Average K and V differences across all 30 layers

entry_comparisons.reported_layer_verification: No excluded layer differs from control; the first changed layer agrees with the bound where a change is present.
entry_comparisons.verification_scope: The manuscript reports the individual-entry check. This public reader checks only the reported aggregate plot inputs.

reported_results.precision: Strings preserve the prose rounding in the current appendix; plot CSVs retain their recorded aggregate precision.

single_sink_read.cutoff_difference_reason: Changing a committing read leaves the intervened block layer-0 KV unchanged; changing clean content does not.

figure.top_panels: Content-change layer maps, log10 positive mean relative KV differences; white cells are exact zeros
figure.bottom_left: Changed sink block: layer-mean KV difference
figure.bottom_right: One sink-reading pass: layer-mean V difference with reported prompt-bootstrap intervals

limitations: The proposition conditions on clean latents, prompt and temporal-position assignments; it is not a forgetting upper bound in free generation.
Older historical context can affect the clean latents through denoising during free generation.
The empirical diagnostic uses released SGF, twenty prompts and generation seed zero.
Relative KV differences measure dependence, not whether that dependence improves generated video.
Self-only single-sink-read intervention changes its read count from three to six frames.
The sixty-second own-entry/layer diagnostic is independent of the older forty-eight-second SGF newest-nine propagation study.
No individual-entry, per-prompt, latent or KV-tensor measurements are exported or rerun here.
